svg.title: AI agent task success rates with Wilson intervals
svg.desc: Observed success rates and 95 percent Wilson intervals for 80 synthetic spreadsheet-cleanup tasks overall and across four task types. The overall rate is 87.5 percent, but its lower bound is 78.5 percent, below the 80 percent release target.
svg.title: Spreadsheet agent task success rates with Wilson intervals

cc:Work.dc:title: Spreadsheet agent task success rates with Wilson intervals
cc:Work.dc:description: A dot-and-interval chart for 80 synthetic spreadsheet-cleanup tasks. The overall observed success rate is 87.5 percent with a 95 percent Wilson interval from 78.5 to 93.1 percent. Mixed-date parsing is the weakest task type at 75.0 percent.
